sourceQuestion: When can a failed/inconclusive thrown-potion experiment identify a substance, what was truly spent, and what does that knowledge prevent or enable next?
distinctConsumer: throwItem harmless-splash branch combines the actual released result with already-revealed polarity/classification to autoIdentify. tryIdentifyLastItemKind also performs constrained partition elimination. Exact distinction is negative evidence becoming decisive under independent class evidence, with conserved expenditure and future functional use/avoidance.

evidence.claim: New-run potion kind identification, revealed polarity and call labels reset; color appearances are shuffled independently of potion function.

Main CE catalogue has eight beneficial kinds, followed by eight malevolent kinds. Hallucination is malevolent and has fixed magnitude 300; life has magnitude 10 and strength 1. Types have genuinely different ingestion/release effects.
Detection marks the individual item and reveals intrinsic polarity for its whole kind, without identifying its exact kind.
A detect-magic potion processes eligible floor items, monster-held items and pack items, then attempts evidence-constrained final-kind identification. It is a potion, not a scroll.

More than one unidentified kind in a polarity partition fails deduction. A sole kind is identified only when its own polarity is known or all opposite-polarity kinds have been identified or polarity-revealed. The dispatcher actually calls the positive and negative partitions; the generic ANY branch is present but is not called here.
Identification mutates the shared kind table, invokes further constrained deduction and names the result; it is retained even when the identifying sample disappears.
Player selects an owned item and target; cancellation at selection or target choice returns before inventory expenditure.
One cloned unit resolves through throwItem, then exactly one pack unit is removed and playerTurnEnded is called.

A potion only shatters under the solid-impact/non-auto-descent condition. Seven malevolent kinds create distinctive terrain effects and auto-identify. A harmless splash is normally inconclusive; hallucination auto-identifies only with individual detection or classification of all eight beneficial kinds. Shattered sample is deleted.
Known/detected malevolent ingestion requests confirmation; declining returns false. Drinking life mutates maxHP and heals; drinking hallucination sets hallucination status to catalogue magnitude 300.
A completed drink auto-identifies if needed, records command and consumes one pack item, returning true.
Cancelled/declined drinking returns before playerTurnEnded; completed potion application ends the player turn.
Future objects of an identified kind use their functional name; unknown objects use appearance or player call label.

Targeting reads known polarity and excludes known-beneficial thrown potions from auto-targets. Hallucination without telepathy disables auto-targeting changing animate appearances. These are selection conveniences, not a blanket manual-throw prohibition.
Hallucination changes animate monster glyph/color and item-category appearance, with explicit telepathy, inanimate/invulnerable and playback exceptions.
Hallucination also substitutes perceived monster names, using cosmetic RNG; telepathy or playback bypasses it.
Ordinary status ticking decrements hallucination; reaching zero redraws the level and reports recovery. Identification is a different table owner and is not cleared here.
The actual drink cost helper decrements quantity by exactly one or removes/deletes the last owned pack item.
Player statuses decrement with objective periodic environment updates, not necessarily one-for-one with player commands. Hallucination magnitude 300 means 300 objective status decrements.

sourceCausalPath.fact: Appearance does not disclose function; actor possesses a potion of a stable but unknown kind. Catalogue types have fixed positive/negative polarity and different consumers.
Drink a detect-magic potion now, spending one bottle and an action. Detection learns broad polarity for currently detectable items/kinds, not precise function.

Choose a potion and supported impact target. Completed throw spends one pack bottle and turn. Harmless splash plus known negative evidence uniquely identifies hallucination; absent independent evidence it remains unknown.
Shared potion-kind table gains identified=true; bottle is destroyed, but the next bottle of this kind is still known. Further partition elimination may identify a remaining type.
Future bottles have functional names. Known harmful drinking asks confirmation; declining spends no bottle/turn. Known beneficial throw auto-targets are avoided. Manual use is still possible.

Drinking hallucination consumes one potion and applies 300 objective status ticks; rendered creatures/items and monster names become unreliable, and auto-targeting changes until ticking expires the condition. Learned identity remains after recovery.

sourceFailures.path: Cancel target or decline known-bad drink: return before consumption/end-turn.
Throw hallucination without detection and without all beneficial kinds classified: harmless splash, deleted sample, pack count -1, action spent, no exact ID.
Throw a beneficial life potion on ordinary ground: harmless splash and consumption, no permanent +10 maxHP/heal that drinking would provide. Harmless result alone is not proof of harmless ingestion.
Drink unknown hallucination: immediate exact ID plus paid bodily/perceptual condition lasting until ordinary recovery.
Two unidentified kinds in the relevant partition, or unknown own polarity with incomplete opposite partition, prevents final-kind deduction.
Shattering condition excludes unsupported auto-descent ground without a solid hit; no assumption that every throw delivers this diagnostic splash.

coverageLimits: Semantic review is only the named functions/ranges, not the whole Brogue repository, game, variants, release history or full terrain/combat engine.

Brogue does not store a structured negative-test receipt in the reviewed harmless-splash branch. It combines evidence available at throw time. Persisting and re-evaluating a negative receipt after later classification is explicitly an original YAIRPG extension.
No source build, game/browser run, private save inspection, gameplay test or balancing check ran.
Source catalogue semantics are not transplanted as world canon; no potion skill, fantasy polarity, dungeon or direct Brogue adaptation is selected.
The exact number of player commands or real-time duration for 300 objective status ticks was not measured; haste/speed can change the relation to actions.

originalProposal.status: original reversible proposal, not accepted fiction, numbers or implementation
originalProposal.title: Identify a destructive wash before spending the only recoverable route rubbing
originalProposal.setting: One optional local Frontier waypost salvage task. Four sealed wash-bottle appearances have authored fixed lot identities: fixative, rinse, etchant and bleaching wash. Add no world/prestige/body system.
originalProposal.publicCatalogue: A learned local catalogue says fixative and rinse are paper-conserving; etchant and bleaching wash are paper-stripping. Etchant reacts on a glazed practice chip; bleaching wash and rinse splash harmlessly; fixative leaves a distinctive film. Appearance and hidden map are never player knowledge.
originalProposal.finiteStock: An explicitly met, willing original steward owns two sealed flasks of each lot, two classification strips, one fragile charcoal route rubbing, and five actual coins held for one accepted preserved-note delivery. Enrollment provisions once; sales/revisits never refill. Names/quantities/prices are proposals.

decisions.cost: Each flask two native coins to the steward; one classification strip one coin; rubbing only transferred under explicit one-time salvage terms. No identity from purchase.
decisions.result: Actual transfer changes seller/player counts and purse.

decisions.action: Spend a strip on one owned flask to learn conserving vs stripping
decisions.cost: One strip, one stamina and two played minutes; tested sealed flask remains owned.
decisions.result: Independent attributed classified evidence. Conserving still leaves fixative/rinse; stripping still leaves etchant/bleach.

decisions.action: Release one owned flask on the glazed practice chip
decisions.cost: One full flask, one stamina and two played minutes; one empty container remains, no refill.
decisions.result: Film or reaction may identify; harmless result alone remains ambiguous. Combining stripping + harmless proves bleaching wash, while conserving + harmless proves rinse. Paid ambiguous test stays paid; later classification can recompute from the original retained receipt.

decisions.action: Use a remaining flask on the unique fragile route rubbing, safely after deduction or as an explicitly uncertain gamble
decisions.cost: One full flask plus one actual fragile rubbing, two stamina and three minutes.
decisions.result: Fixative yields one Preserved route rubbing; bleach/etchant yields one Spoiled route rubbing; rinse yields the fragile rubbing back without preservation. The hidden truth determines physical result, not the player naming it. Destructive use is a disclosed possibility but unseen exact outcome must not leak in preview.

decisions.action: Keep the preserved rubbing or deliver it for the stated escrow
decisions.cost: Delivery transfers one actual Preserved route rubbing to the willing steward and deducts five coins from that actor’s actual purse, crediting player native money once.
decisions.result: Retained useful native output or funded settlement. Spoiled rubbing cannot satisfy delivery; no replacement rubbing, restored payment, automatic refund or repeat reward.

originalProposal.sourceInspiredInvariant: An inconclusive material result can become decisive with independent category evidence; an experiment spends real means even when no precise identity or useful product is obtained.
originalProposal.originalExtension: Persistent negative receipts and recomputation after later evidence. Brogue currently checks its harmless-splash inference at impact time.
originalProposal.actualUsefulConsumer: The apply command physically preserves, leaves unresolved, or destroys a unique native rubbing. Inferred identity lets the player conserve remaining fixative and avoid bleaching the only deliverable. The deliver command consumes preserved output and real funded purse, not a knowledge flag or invented reward.
originalProposal.doNotDuplicate: Do not reuse/edit the pale reed-oil vial, oil ID fact, Eda fixed assay or its existing native projector. No global randomized unknown-item catalogue is required for this finite original lot.

integrationShape.compatibility: Prefer additive namespaced primitive facts and existing knowledge receipts with explicit enrollment. New IDs require this fork registry. integrationShape.failureSemantics: Cancellation/refund before a specimen is actually released grants no observation. A completed ambiguous or destructive experiment retains actual spent material. A support-loss refund/forfeit policy must be disclosed and use the existing executor. Stale commands, absent buyer funds, borrowed/equipped flasks, insufficient stamina/stock or wrong location fail before publication.

laterPlayableGate: On generated saves and matching rebuild, purchase/classify/test visibly spends exact owned inputs; unknown names never leak catalogue truth; no rendering side effects.

Harmless trial alone retains multiple candidates; stripping+harmless proves bleach; conserving+harmless proves rinse. Reordered later classification reuses actual negative evidence, repeated trials consume remaining finite stock and never duplicate receipts/rewards.

Applying inferred fixative physically creates preserved native rubbing; applying bleach destroys it; rinse leaves it fragile. Correct evidence does not conjure bottles or automatically preserve anything.

Keeping versus funded delivery transfers exact rubbing and five actual steward coins; failed/destructive path cannot claim escrow. Save/reload/import at each branch preserves spent sample, inferred identity, output and finite purse.

Injected save failure, stale commands, cancellation/completion support loss, custody/equipment exclusion, keyboard/focus and director review. All gameplay/save/failure/browser/regression gates remain deferred under current phase.
